title: Source-first system operating metrics dashboard
summary: This iteration adds a first-screen system operating dashboard after the source metrics dashboard. The public page now summarizes content scale, active signal modules, trend and tracking volume, source coverage, and reader-safe quality status before the source status focus and long inventory.

validation_commands: node --test --test-name-pattern "source inventory|source-first runtime|source metrics dashboard|source-first IA|source signal story|system operating dashboard" tests/unit.test.js
Playwright screenshot check for #section-system-operating-dashboard at 1280x1100 and 390x1200

degraded_sections.message: The 2026-06-29 page-check still reports the existing community_cards_reader_facing degraded check, but no blocking checks are present and this iteration does not modify community card rendering.

lessons.lesson: The system operating dashboard should be a renderer-level layer, not another fixed source-order contract entry.
lessons.evidence: The green page-check records #section-system-operating-dashboard at index 2, after source metrics and before source status focus, while the source-first order remains source_signal_story, source_first_dashboard, source_status_focus, source_map, and source_inventory.
lessons.recommended_action: Keep the system dashboard inserted by report rendering and avoid adding it to config/source-display-contract.json unless the source order contract itself changes.

lessons.lesson: A system metrics card can summarize reader-safe public arrays without leaking review internals.
lessons.evidence: The unit test and page-check require five cards and tags SYSTEM_CONTENT, SYSTEM_SIGNALS, SYSTEM_TRENDS, SYSTEM_SOURCES, and SYSTEM_QUALITY, and reject internal review fields in the serialized dashboard or rendered text.
lessons.recommended_action: When adding new system metrics, bind them to public arrays or sanitized quality status and add page-check assertions before exposing them.

lessons.lesson: Visual validation catches reader-facing language issues that structural checks can miss.
lessons.evidence: The first screenshot pass showed an English quality note from a real report; the implementation now maps English quality notes to a generic Chinese reader-facing degradation note while preserving the raw machine status value in stats.
lessons.recommended_action: Continue pairing page-check gates with desktop and mobile screenshots for first-screen public metrics work.

followups.action: Continue the roadmap by refining the fixed source importance handbook and source insertion workflow, using the same red-green-page-check pattern.
